name: Gyüre (Hungary)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gyüre (a quartered red, blue and white shield with a trefoil, a patriarchal cross, a fish and a wavy stripe) below a white scroll inscribed GYÜRE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
